comment: Generated by tools/build-body-meshes.mjs. Do not edit; rebuild.
Every structure listed under `structures` is in both mesh files, as the same table slot. Its id is its FMA number.
Positions are BD's own chart: BodyParts3D millimetres, LAS (+x subject left, +y anterior, +z superior).
Display geometry only: no structure here has an ALC-1 address it did not already have. BD stays the addressing frame.

frame.space: BodyParts3D 4.0 millimetres, LAS: the chart the BD template is measured in

registration.basis: The BD template was measured on these BodyParts3D meshes in this chart. tools/check-mesh-assets.mjs re-derives its per-level axis points and vertebral centroids from the committed full tier on every run.

build.simplifier: meshoptimizer 1.3.0 simplify(), LockBorder; topology-preserving edge collapse
build.errorMeasure: symmetric Hausdorff and mean surface distance, every vertex, exact nearest-surface, millimetres

exclusions.reason: the brain is its own atlas (DOG-127, W2); the body does not ship a second brain

fullTierUndecimated.why: the 25 BD vertebrae: the registration gate re-derives BD level points from them
